name: Auto-Arcana
description:
About This Game

What kind of Arcanist will you become? With only six skillbar slots and a plethora of spells to draft, craft, and loot, you’ll need to make tough decisions. Fuse spells to discover over 10,000 unique combinations, arrange them into devastating combos, and break the game in this roguelike auto-battler.

Spells trigger from left to right and impact each other, so clever sequencing can make or break your build. Use an ice spell to freeze your opponent before immediately casting Shatter for massive damage, or chain spells that apply Burning and Frozen Solid before casting a debuff-amplifying curse.

Every Arcanist’s spellbook is unique. Fuse different spells together to forge your own custom spells, and then modify them further with transformative runestones! Specialize in a single element to empower your strongest spells, or mix several to access unique cross-element effects.

Watch your strategy unfold. Luck is not a factor in combat: your success is determined by your prior decisions, mistakes and triumphs. You’ll never lose a fight because of an unlucky card draw or roll of the dice.

Assemble a deadly combo that can crush any foe, or meticulously adjust your build to counter each opponent’s strategy. Facing an Elite who attacks multiple times on turn 3? Adjust a Shielding spell’s cooldown so that it triggers just before their barrage, or craft a new Feedback spell to reflect the damage back at your attacker.

Render your opponents permanently frozen, force them to flee combat before they deal a single point of damage, or chain 1-cooldown lightning bolts to destroy your foe before they take their first turn.

But don’t get complacent: there’s always a stronger spell to rebuild your strategy around, and a deadlier foe lying in wait.
short_desc: Devise the ultimate spell rotation and watch it obliterate your foes in this roguelike auto-battler. Seek forbidden knowledge to craft overpowered spells, assemble devastating combos, and break the game.
